verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at the 6–6.5 anchor because its spacious, clearly sectioned layout remains readable with effort, but very small text and several long perimeter detours prevent fluent arm’s-length reading.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and label chips have generous clear space, but the labels are extremely small relative to the full board and some chips sit close to edge traffic.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Numbered framed regions and two large lower sections make membership clear without tracing edges, although the section tint is very faint.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Local connectors are generally clean, but the red and orange failure paths make long perimeter mega-detours, while the publication branches require substantial backtracking.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: Air strongly outweighs ink and most sections contain only two to four nodes; the main failure is excess unused canvas rather than crowding.
